title: Zeus Juice Mortals - Hydra 100ml shortfill E-Liquid
description: Hydra from Zeus Juice’s Mortals collection is a many-headed beast, writhing with delicious flavours including fresh, succulent strawberries, luscious grapes, fragrant, and tropical dragon fruit, all given a spicy kick from aniseed to create an ejuice that’s uniquely complex and utterly moreish. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , vape mod kits and sub-ohm tanks .
